compatibility: Retains wire-v2 field offsets through byte 195. Header packet_size becomes 230 and version becomes 3. Updated receivers also accept the unchanged 164-byte v1 and 200-byte v2 layouts. Old receivers cannot decode v3; update the bridge before using a v3 sender.
common_fields: espnow_telemetry_wire_v1.json through byte 159; espnow_telemetry_wire_v2.json tilt fields at bytes 160..195

resolved_extension.source: Applied SystemParams, refreshed at producer configure; fill is the common mass_fill field at byte 112.

canonical_json.legacy: v1/v2 omit resolved entirely; clients must not infer agreement from preset name alone.

frame_semantics: IMU remains raw sensor coordinates. When device_frame_transform is true, body x=-raw y, body y=(raw x+raw z)/sqrt(2), body z=(raw z-raw x)/sqrt(2). Internal body z points toward wrist; semantic forward is -body z. When false, the transform is identity. No gravity filtering state is transported.
validation: v2 semantic checks plus known family/flags, finite positive spans and finite [0,1] fill/headspace/viscosity/particle_count/particle_hardness.
